readiness.engineering_scope: Retained forecast outcome/news observation; source diagnostics and bounded publication retry

review_checks: First observed before target; no historical issuance import
Exact original endpoint and matched no-change control
Immutable first observations and duplicate suppression
Per-registry and horizon scores; no pooled model ranking
Source revisions and missing outcomes refused or retried with bounded fairness
Optional inference/import/reporting cannot interrupt news capture
Original source/model/normalizer/target identities preserved apart from reviewed reader metadata and source bindings
No reset of native restart circuit/history
